name: Sure Safe EFS
organization_description:
Sure Safe’s history dates to 1986, with nearly 40 years of experience developing and installing engineered foundation solutions. Sure Safe EFS, Inc. specializes in crawl-space, post-and-pier, modular, and manufactured home foundations.
Unlike conventional repairs that rely on isolated posts or piers, Sure Safe designs coordinated foundation systems that improve load distribution and provide a continuous load path from the home into the supporting soil.
Sure Safe developed the proprietary VR-1 Foundation System, recognized under ICC-ES ESR-4921, and the Steel Buttress Foundation System. Our systems are engineered for each structure, professionally installed, permitted where required, and backed by a lifetime transferable warranty.
Services: Foundation Repair, Seismic Retrofit, Foundation Inspections, VR-1 Systems, Manufactured & Modular Home Foundations, Load-Transfer Girders.
